items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 17 at 3:46PM EDT until October 19 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level expected in
low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Areas along Bogue Banks beaches, Bogue Sound, the
Newport and White Oak Rivers, and adjacent tidal creeks.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Sunday to 11 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Up to 1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level is
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in a low threat of property damage. Some roads and
low lying property including parking lots, parks, lawns, and
homes adjacent to the waterfront will experience shallow
flooding.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 17 at 3:03PM EDT until October 20 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
12 to 17 ft. Occasional gusts up to 50 kt through early evening.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City,
and the offshore waters from Cape Lookout to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until midnight EDT Monday night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
